workflows.description: One-off, dispatch-only quarantine for the per-m² measure program's W2 heal. ceskereality, realitymix and bazos each render commercial and land offers at a RATE ("100 Kč za m²/měsíc", "45 Kč / (za m²)") and the pre-W1 parsers wrote that rate into `price_czk`, which every consumer reads as a total. Unlike the mmreality area damage this is NOT repairable — the true total was never on the page — so it is a QUARANTINE: `price_czk` goes to NULL and the convicting text is recorded in `raw_json.unit_price_quarantined_*`, reversible until the next refetch repopulates the price correctly through W1's parse-time rail. A row is quarantined ONLY when the portal's own price cell, re-read from already-staged state, carries the anchored per-area marker (CONFIRMATION, NEVER MAGNITUDE); rows whose cell cannot be read are left alone and counted as `unconfirmed`. bazos confirms nothing by design — its cell is a bare "170 Kč" and the m² basis lives only in prose — and stays wired to report that zero honestly. `price_czk` is in the content hash but this writes NO snapshot, on the same reasoning as the mmreality heal. The read is keyset-paginated and exhaustive; a pass that stopped early logs "BACKFILL INCOMPLETE" with a `--after` resume cursor, and silence means done.

Re-attributes a rotating lap of broker-bearing listings from raw_json (keyset-batched so the raw_json scan never times out over the pooler), recomputes ALL broker rollups + memberships in ONE merged statement (recompute_brokers(None), Broker Unify W3 — the old 9-window loop paid ~27 full index walks and 100+ min), rebuilds firm rollups, runs the cross-source merge step, generates candidates, and clears the dirty queue — the self-healing backstop for anything the incremental drain missed. It no longer publishes the leaderboard matview: that is the drain path's job (hourly-if-stale, the realtime worker's broker lane), so serving freshness stopped depending on this job's length or its GH-cron-drifted start time. Nominally runs after the property recompute (04:15); in practice GH throttling drifts both into the same mid-morning window. mode=backfill is the same code path (the first population); dispatch it once after this lands on main. workflows.name: Monitoring: health canary (hourly)
workflows.description: The health canary: the one monitoring workflow, and the one alarm path that needs neither Supabase's scheduler (pg_cron) nor Railway. Each run records failed production runs, measures the GitHub-hosted health checks that are due, then asserts that the watchers and the teller are alive. Only those assertions are meant to turn a run red, and GitHub emails the operator about a red scheduled run.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Measure and log the due checks without storing results or registry rows (the poller and the assertions still run)

workflows.name: Scraping: Web index walk
workflows.description: The tenth portal's walk: `web` is any site an operator pasted (scraper/web_main.py). It has no index, so the walk pages nothing and reaches its end at once; the portal's declared `indexless` seam then nominates every active web ad that has no queue row and no page check in the last 24 h (NULL categories included) at the verify priority. The worker's drain fetches each page and the page decides (rule #3): a live page refreshes the ad, a 404/410 or a redirect off the page records a gone verdict, and a second one 24 h+ later closes it. Records run_type='index'.

inputs.name: max_seconds
inputs.description: wall-clock budget; the walk finalizes cleanly before this (blank = 300).
